mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deli_sync_log ( deli_sync_log_id, sync_started_at, sync_completed_at, sync_status, record_count, new_record_count, duplicate_count, error_message, sync_time_range_start, sync_time_range_end, execution_duration_ms, created_at ) VALUES ( #{logId}, #{startedAt}, NULL, 'IN_PROGRESS', 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, #{syncTimeRangeStart}, #{syncTimeRangeEnd}, NULL, #{startedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE deli_sync_log SET sync_completed_at = #{completedAt}, sync_status = 'SUCCESS', record_count = #{recordCount}, error_message = NULL, execution_duration_ms = #{executionDurationMs} WHERE deli_sync_log_id = #{logId} AND sync_status = 'IN_PROGRESS'

UPDATE deli_sync_log SET sync_completed_at = #{completedAt}, sync_status = 'FAILED', record_count = #{recordCount}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, execution_duration_ms = #{executionDurationMs} WHERE deli_sync_log_id = #{logId} AND sync_status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(sync_completed_at, sync_started_at) AS last_sync_time, COALESCE(record_count, 0) AS record_count, sync_status AS status, error_message FROM deli_sync_log WHERE sync_status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED') ORDER BY sync_started_at DESC, deli_sync_log_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT sync_time_range_end FROM deli_sync_log WHERE sync_status = 'SUCCESS' AND sync_time_range_end IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sync_time_range_end DESC, deli_sync_log_id DESC LIMIT 1
